# 00000002057

**UA-07 ★** — source: 54_泛代数与范畴论.md

**English.** Definition: Natural duality is the Clark–Davey dualizing embedding. Conjecture: The full dualization of the quasivariety generated by A₅ is given by the smallest topological closure of relations; the closure dimension is 2 (i.e. exactly 2 generating relations are needed).

**中文。** 定义：自然对偶指 Clark–Davey 的对偶化嵌入。猜想：A₅ 生成的拟簇的全对偶化由关系的最小拓扑闭包给出;闭包维数为 2(即需恰好 2 个生成关系)。
